This is the first post in a Quarto blog. Welcome!

![écoute](/www/img/ear.jpg){fig-align="left" width="200"}
entendre par ses oreilles avec la capacité d'entendre mieux que les statues pour concentrer son intérêt sur le langage spirituel nouveau, certes inconnu mais au sens parfaitement intelligible à l'esprit.


### to hear, listen to, obey

1. (Qal)
<ol type="A">
<li>to hear (**perceive by ear**)</li>
<li>to hear of or concerning</li>
<li> to hear (**have power to hear**)</li>
<li>to hear **with attention or interest**, listen to</li>
<li>to **understand (language)**</li>
<li>to hear (of judicial cases)</li>
<li>to listen, give heed</li>
    to consent, agree
    to grant request
<li>to listen to, yield to</li>
<li>**to obey**, be obedient</li>
</ol>

2. (Niphal)
<ol type="A">
<li> to be heard (of voice or sound)</li>
<li>to be heard of</li>
<li> to be regarded, be obeyed</li>
</ol>

3. (Piel) to cause to hear, call to hear, summon

4. (Hiphil)
<ol type="A">
<li>to cause to hear, tell, proclaim, utter a sound</li>
<li>to sound aloud (musical term)</li>
<li>to make proclamation, summon</li>
<li>to cause to be heard</li>
</ol>
